I have reviewed the conversation history, but I do not see any specific supply items, quantities, or prices listed that would constitute a supply order. The notes provided so far relate to room availability, maintenance issues (repainting, noise), equipment status (coffee machines, lifts), and meeting logistics.

Since there are no line items to add up, I cannot calculate a total. If you have a list of supplies you'd like to add to the order, please provide them, and I will be happy to calculate the total for you.
